Disc method (region touches the axis):
- Each slice is a circle with radius r(x), the distance from the curve to the axis
- Area of one slice is π r²
- Volume: V = π ∫ from a to b of r(x)² dx

Inner radius r = x², so r² = (x²)², not x².
Outer radius R = x (the higher curve, y = x).

Two-sample t-test (independent groups)
H₀: μ₁ = μ₂ (no difference)
Conclusion: Because p = 0.004 is less than α = 0.05, we reject H₀.
Torque: τ = r·F·sin θ, and I = 0.4·m·r² for a sphere.

Henderson-Hasselbalch: pH = pKa + log([A⁻]/[HA])
When [A⁻] = [HA], the log term is zero, so pH = pKa.
